title: Cedar Grilled Plank Pilaf
description: A unique and flavorful pilaf dish grilled to perfection on a cedar plank, perfect for a summer evening.
instructions: Soak the cedar plank in water for 30 minutes.
In a medium saucepan, heat the olive oil over medium heat.
Add the pilaf and cook for 2-3 minutes until lightly toasted.
Add the grapes, craving spices, and midnight salt to the saucepan. Stir to combine.
Place the soaked cedar plank on the grill and cook for 2-3 minutes until slightly charred.
Transfer the pilaf mixture to the cedar plank and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes.
Remove from heat and let rest for 1-2 minutes before serving.
Slice the cedar plank into individual portions and serve hot.
